visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a large ceramic bowl filled with sauerkraut fish, garnished with vibrant red dried chilies and yellow flower petals. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a building where a large crowd of people is queuing along a covered walkway; the individuals are dressed in casual summer attire. (3) The camera moves to the restaurant entrance, showing a wooden counter and a red mat that says 'WELCOME' in English and Chinese. (4) A male server wearing a black shirt and a mask carries a large white platter of food towards a table. (5) A series of close-up shots feature various food items being lifted with ladles and chopsticks: tender white fish slices, meatballs, shrimp paste, thin beef slices, and wide translucent noodles. (6) Side dishes like crispy golden fried chicken and seasoned cucumber slices are shown on black plates. (7) A hand pours hot water from a red tap into a white mug containing dried herbs. (8) The final shots show the empty modern interior of the restaurant with gray booths and green plants, followed by the external storefront with large signage reading 'Diao Min Asia Sauerkraut Fish'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 刁民酸菜魚開來高雄啦. (2) [Subtitle]: 一開店就排爆 人潮真的超誇張. (3) [Subtitle]: 我們也忍不住來嚐鮮 想知道它到底紅什麼. (4) [Subtitle]: 為您送上我們的中盛酸菜魚. (5) [Subtitle]: 酸菜魚會淋上花椒香料油. (6) [Subtitle]: 融合了酸辣 胡椒香 辣感溫和不嗆喉. (7) [Subtitle]: 魚片選用烏鱧魚 肉質滑嫩 真的很下飯. (8) [Subtitle]: 加料推薦手工丸和蝦滑. (9) [Subtitle]: 還有雪花牛 吸飽湯汁的寬冬粉. (10) [Subtitle]: 再加一份老油條或沙漏魚皮也很讚. (11) [Subtitle]: 很多人會點 硬硬的炸雞. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們最喜歡開胃的啪啪黃瓜. (13) [Subtitle]: 搭配神級奶茶 陳釀烏梅汁剛剛好. (14) [Subtitle]: 內用有免費沖泡的陳皮洛神茶可以喝. (15) [Subtitle]: 這裡開到凌晨兩點 喜歡酸菜魚的一定要來試試. (16) [Logo]: 刁民酸菜魚. [Slogan]: 刁民酸菜魚 高雄富裕店 高雄市左營區裕誠路453號. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food vlog introducing the new Kaohsiung branch of the popular 'Diao Min Asia Sauerkraut Fish'. It aims to attract customers by showcasing the restaurant's popularity (the queue), the appetizing visual presentation of its signature dish, the variety of high-quality ingredients, and its late-night operating hours.
